## Changelog

- Updated the CN and Global editions to official Wuwa Tappo 1.0.5, including random public-room joining and room visibility controls.
- Added Mac support for Reset App and network diagnostics. Reset App restores defaults and keeps local click counts available for recovery.
- Added shortcuts for Always on Top, automatic Game Mode in fullscreen, and disabling pointer monitoring. Existing shortcuts carry forward.
- Adapted toast dismissal, pointer hover and display-switch recovery for macOS.

## Instructions

- Requires Apple Silicon and macOS 13 or later. Choose CN or Global to match your account.
- Use **Settings → Check for Updates → Update and Restart**, or quit the app and replace it with the matching DMG or ZIP build.
- If macOS blocks launch, use **System Settings → Privacy & Security → Open Anyway**.
- Both packages contain `Wuwa Tappo.app`. Install them in separate folders if you use both editions. The `.app.tar.gz` and `.sig` files are for the in-app updater.
